 Carolina Panthers The Carolina Panthers are going to have a hard time against the Denver Broncos on Sunday. The Broncos are 6-2 and have one of the best defenses in the NFL. This could be a really bad matchup for fantasy owners counting on Carolina's offense.

 While the Carolina offense has shown flashes this season, there are still plenty of question marks surrounding several of the Panthers' offensive players. In particular, Bryce Young, Jalen Coker and Darren Waller present three different fantasy decisions heading into Sunday's matchup.

 Bryce Young: Sit
